packs.name: Cold Vault
packs.description: Dark, ominous minor-key trap: phrygian half-step moves, harmonic-minor V7s and pedal bass under shifting upper voices.

packs.name: Neon Grief
packs.description: Sad, melodic trap chords with borrowed minor iv colour, 9ths and 11ths and slow-burn resolutions.

packs.name: Velvet Bando
packs.description: Atlanta-style trap keys made for bounce: syncopated stabs, pulses and anticipations that sit in the pocket with the hats.

packs.name: Iron Bells
packs.description: Bell-led trap voicings in a high, glassy register, written to be arpeggiated or played on chimes and music boxes.

packs.name: Midnight Ivory
packs.description: Piano-led trap progressions with rolled extended voicings, chromatic bass lines and half-time ballads.

progressions.title: Bando Cathedral
progressions.description: A C minor pedal that leans on a Dbmaj7 half step above it, then falls through Abmaj7 to a harmonic-minor G7b9. Arp it on a bell and leave the 808 room on beat one.

progressions.title: 808 Seance
progressions.description: F#m(maj7) and a phrygian Gmaj7 over the same F# pedal, then Dmaj7 and a C#7b9 that pulls straight back home. The stabs keep it tense; let the bass ring.

progressions.title: Crypt Hi-Hats
progressions.description: Seven bars of D pedal while the inner voice creeps C, C#, C, Bb, then a phrygian Ebmaj7 and an A7b9 turnaround. Pulse it in eighths under fast hats.

progressions.title: Gutter Requiem
progressions.description: A long Bbm11 that slips to Gbmaj7#11, the minor iv as Ebm9 and a gritty F7#9 dominant. Written for half-time drums at 144.

progressions.title: Phrygian Trenches
progressions.description: Em add9 against a phrygian Fmaj7 over the E pedal, then a fast Cmaj9 to B7b9 kick at the end of the loop.

progressions.title: Trap House Lanterns
progressions.description: Gm9 to Ebmaj7#11 with the A held on top, the Cm11 iv, then D7b9 from harmonic minor. Roll each chord for a dark, wide pad.

progressions.title: Trap Choir Ruins
progressions.description: Two long bars each of Am9 and Fmaj7#11, then Dm9 into the Neapolitan Bbmaj7 and a sour E7#9. Put it on a choir or string pad.

progressions.title: Ominous 808 Tolls
progressions.description: Ebm with the seventh sliding D to Db, the bVI as Cbmaj7 and a Bb7b9 with Cb on top. Arpeggiate fast on a toy-bell patch.

progressions.title: Trap Fog Sermon
progressions.description: C#m11 up a half step to Dmaj7, then Amaj9 and a G#7b9 that sets the A against the root. Short stabs, long 808.

progressions.title: 808 Lullaby Ruins
progressions.description: Fm9 and Dbmaj7#11 share most of their notes, then a minor ii-V of Gm7b5 to C7b9 holds the tension for two bars. Half-time piano at 140.

progressions.title: Bando Phantom
progressions.description: Bm add9, then Cmaj7 hanging over the B pedal for the phrygian rub, Gmaj7 and a low F#7b9. Bounce it under a sliding 808.

progressions.title: Gravel Trap Omen
progressions.description: i-bVI-bVII in G# minor dressed as G#m9, Emaj7 and F# add9, with a harmonic-minor D#7b9 to turn it. Each chord lands an eighth early.

progressions.title: 808 Heartache
progressions.description: i-bVI-bVII-V in A minor with add9 colour, then a darker second half through Fmaj7#11, Dm9 and E7b9. The top line is the hook.

progressions.title: Hi-Hat Halo
progressions.description: Bright Ebmaj9 and Cm11, then Abmaj7#11 turns into the borrowed Abm6 for the sad drop. Pulse it under rolling hats.

progressions.title: Drip Rain Ballad
progressions.description: Dm11, Bbmaj9 and Gm9 with an A7sus4 that resolves its suspension into A7b9 inside the last bar. Roll it on a soft piano.

progressions.title: Trap Goodbye Letter
progressions.description: F#m9, Dmaj7 and Bm9 into a suspended C#7, then the second pass sneaks in the Neapolitan Gmaj7#11 before C#7b9.

progressions.title: Ice Chain Tears
progressions.description: Cm9, Abmaj9 and Fm9 in a slow half-time sway, with a Neapolitan Dbmaj7 and a G7b13 squeezed into the last bar.

progressions.title: Bando Moonlight
progressions.description: Major-key sad trap: Gmaj9 and Em11, then the borrowed Cm add9 darkens it before a suspended D7 resolves to D7b9.

progressions.title: Lost Trap Voicemail
progressions.description: i-bVI-bIII in Bb minor, then Fsus4 resolving to F7b9. Voiced high so a fast arp sounds like a melody on its own.

progressions.title: Rainfall 808
progressions.description: Bm11 for two bars, Gmaj9 and Em9, then the Neapolitan Cmaj7#11 and an F#7#9 that hangs for the whole last two bars.

progressions.title: Sad Trap Polaroid
progressions.description: Abmaj7 to Fm9 and Dbmaj9, then Db turns minor for two beats before a suspended Eb7 loops it back.

progressions.title: Hi-Hat Elegy
progressions.description: Em9, Cmaj7 and Am11, then B7b9 pushes its fifth up to G for B7#5 so the loop leans back into Em.

progressions.title: Lonely Trap Satellite
progressions.description: Fmaj9 and Am7, then the IV turns minor (Bbmaj7 to Bbm6) before Gm9 and C7sus4. Bittersweet major for melodic trap.

progressions.title: Bando Lullaby
progressions.description: A chromatic bass walk G, F#, F, E under a held Gm, landing on Ebmaj7 and D7b9. Classic sad descent at half-time.

progressions.title: Peachtree Trap Bounce
progressions.description: C#m7, Amaj7 and F#m9 with the G# held on top, then a G#7#9 for bite. Bounce it and let the 808 follow the roots.

progressions.title: Trap Boulevard Stabs
progressions.description: Gm7 flicking up to a phrygian Abmaj7 and back, then F add9, Ebmaj9 and D7#9. Short stabs on the syncopations.

progressions.title: Chrome Rims Pulse
progressions.description: i-bVI-bVII with Fm9 and Dbmaj9, a suspended Eb that resolves, then a C7b9 to drag it back to F minor.

progressions.title: Trap Mansion Strut
progressions.description: Ebm9 and Abm9 with smooth common tones, the bVI as Cbmaj7, and a Bb7#9 with the sharp nine on top.

progressions.title: Hi-Hat Parade
progressions.description: Am7 up a half step to a phrygian Bbmaj7, down to Fmaj7 and out through E7b9. Built for fast stabs.

progressions.title: Trap Velour
progressions.description: Bm9 moving to Gmaj7 and A6 in quick halves, Em7, then a suspended F#7 that resolves. Anticipated for a lazy swing.

progressions.title: Bando Coupe Glide
progressions.description: Abmaj9, Fm7, Dbmaj7 and a suspended Eb that opens into Eb9. Bright, smooth Atlanta-style bounce.

progressions.title: Trap Drumline Strut
progressions.description: Dm9 against a phrygian Ebmaj7 twice (the second with a sharp eleven), then Bbmaj7, Gm9 and two bars of A7b9.

progressions.title: Plug Talk Groove
progressions.description: Cm11 and Abmaj7, then Bb6 to Bb7 and Gm7 turning major as G7#9. Quick changes in the second half keep it bouncing.

progressions.title: Trap Lobby Lights
progressions.description: Major-key trap: Emaj9, C#m9 and Amaj7#11, then the borrowed Am6 and a suspended B7. Pulse it for a glossy feel.

progressions.title: Ice Grill Stabs
progressions.description: Bbm7 rocking against Cbmaj7 over the Bb pedal, then Gbmaj7, Ebm9 and F7b9. Tight stabs, menacing low end.

progressions.title: Bando Rooftop Bounce
progressions.description: F#m11, Dmaj9 and E6 (i-bVI-bVII), then a C#7#9 with the sharp nine on top. Smooth upper voices, bouncing hits.

progressions.title: Bando Bell Tower
progressions.description: A line cliché over D minor (D, C#, C, B) for four bars, then Bbmaj7, Gm9, a Neapolitan Ebmaj7#11 and A7b9. Arp it on bells.

progressions.title: 808 Music Box
progressions.description: Am add9, Fmaj7 and Cmaj7 over G in a high music-box register, then Dm9 and E7b9. Written for half-time.

progressions.title: Glacier Trap Chimes
progressions.description: Dmaj9, Bm9 and Gmaj7#11 high and glassy, then the IV turns minor as Gm6 before a suspended A7.

progressions.title: Haunted Trap Carillon
progressions.description: Cm(maj9) relaxing to Cm9, then Abmaj7, a Neapolitan Dbmaj7 and G7b9. The B to Bb to C motion on top carries the melody.

progressions.title: Trap Icicle Bells
progressions.description: G#m11, Emaj9 and C#m9 voiced up high, then D#7b9 for the harmonic-minor pull. Fast arps on a glock or bell.

progressions.title: Bando Wind Chimes
progressions.description: Em add9 and Cmaj9, Gmaj7 over D, then a Bsus4 resolving to B7. Pulse it on a bell with lots of reverb.

progressions.title: Trap Chandelier
progressions.description: Ebm9, Cbmaj7 and Abm9 with Bb on top throughout, then Bb7#5 and Bb7b9 as a two-step dominant.

progressions.title: Ghost Bell 808
progressions.description: Two bars of C#m add9, Amaj9 and F#m9, then a Neapolitan Dmaj7#11 and two bars of G#7b9. Half-time and haunted.

progressions.title: Trap Steeple
progressions.description: Fm add9 up a half step to a phrygian Gbmaj7, then Dbmaj9 and C7b9. Sparse bell voicings for fast arps.

progressions.title: Frostbite Trap Bells
progressions.description: Bm9, Gmaj9, Em9 and a Neapolitan Cmaj7#11, then a second pass with an A#dim7 passing chord into F#7b9.

progressions.title: Dungeon Bell Ritual
progressions.description: Gm9 to a phrygian Abmaj7, Ebmaj7 over G, then F#dim7 sliding into D7b9.

progressions.title: Hollow Trap Glockenspiel
progressions.description: Cmaj9, Am9 and Fmaj7#11, then the borrowed Fm6 and a suspended G7. Pulse it on a glockenspiel.

progressions.title: Trap Piano Confession
progressions.description: Dbmaj9, Bbm11 and Gbmaj7#11, then the borrowed Gbm6 and a suspended Ab7. Roll each chord on a warm upright.

progressions.title: Bando Nocturne
progressions.description: Em11 for two bars, Cmaj7#11 and Am9, then a phrygian Fmaj7 and a B7#9 for the last two bars. Half-time piano at 144.

progressions.title: 808 Prayer Keys
progressions.description: Amaj9 and F#m11, then the IV goes minor (Dmaj7 to Dm6) and E7sus4 resolves into E7b9. Sad major trap on piano.

progressions.title: Trap Hymnal
progressions.description: A descending bass Bb, A, Ab, G under Bb minor, landing on Gbmaj7 and F7b9. Roll it on a dark grand.

progressions.title: Trap Rose Piano
progressions.description: C#m9, Amaj7 and E over G#, then a quick F#m9 to G#7b9. Pushed an eighth early for an emotional, rushing feel.

progressions.title: Late Trap Sonata
progressions.description: Two bars each of Gm11 and Ebmaj9, then Cm9, a Neapolitan Abmaj7 and two bars of D7b9. A half-time ballad.

progressions.title: Bando Keys Diary
progressions.description: Abm9, Fbmaj7 and Dbm9 keep Eb in the voicing, then Eb7b9 adds the harmonic-minor G. Deep, rolled piano.

progressions.title: Trap Prelude Rain
progressions.description: Bbmaj9 and Gm9, the IV going from Ebmaj7#11 to a borrowed Ebm6, then F7sus4 opening into F13.

progressions.title: 808 Ivory Smoke
progressions.description: Fm11, Dbmaj7 and Bbm9, then Ebsus4 and an Edim7 passing chord that climbs back into F minor.

progressions.title: Trap Velvet Etude
progressions.description: Bmaj9 and G#m9, then Emaj7#11 turning minor as Em6 and a suspended F#7 to loop. Rolled and warm.

progressions.title: Penthouse Trap Reverie
progressions.description: Gbmaj9, Ebm11 and Cbmaj7, then the IV turns minor for two bars before a suspended Db7 resolves to Db7b9.

progressions.title: Trap Requiem Keys
progressions.description: F#m9 against a phrygian Gmaj7 over the F# pedal, then Dmaj7#11 and a C#7#9. Rolled dark piano.
